section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Oct 29 $6.0B Walmart Expansion vs. Customer Concentration & GreenBox / Non-WMT Diversification
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Skeptical shorts (31.55% short float) argue that the Oct 29 Walmart Enterprise Master Agreement deepens reliance on a single customer (>85% of backlog) while independent third-party enterprise wins (Target, Albertsons, C&S, GreenBox) remain slow to ramp.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Walmart's $6.0B new commitment (up to $6.92B backlog addition + $125M R&D DPA for next-gen racking/picking) expands Symbotic into Walmart's international Americas ambient centers and funds proprietary IP Symbotic can subsequently monetize across GreenBox and European cold-chain/micro-fulfillment via cellumation.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CEO Rick Cohen: Following the October 29 $6.0B Walmart Enterprise Master Agreement, how much of the $125M R&D DPA unlocks modular architecture for GreenBox and non-Walmart grocers, and when do international Americas deployments begin recognizing revenue?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Gross Margin Ceiling (~22%–25%) & M&A Integration Drag (Walmart ASR, Fox Robotics, cellumation) vs. Software Mix
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Shares slid -14.88% after Q3 FY26 despite an EPS/EBITDA beat as management signaled near-term gross margin stabilization around ~22%–25% and absorbed R&D/SG&A from integrating Walmart ASR, Fox Robotics, and Germany's cellumation GmbH.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: High-margin recurring Software Maintenance & Support ($12.77M, +57% YoY) and Operation Services ($37.12M, +49% YoY) are scaling rapidly as the operational system base hits 56+ sites, creating a structural multi-year gross margin tailwind toward 28%–30% as systems complete installation.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CFO Izzy Martins: Now that 56+ systems are operational and Software + Operation Services reached ~$50M/quarter (+51% YoY), what is the gross margin bridge for FY27 once Fox Robotics and cellumation integration costs normalize?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Working Capital Volatility (-$147.3M Q3 OCF) & Up-C Share Structure vs. 31.55% Short Squeeze Setup
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Bears point to Q3's -$147.30M OCF outflow (which pulled cash from $2.01B to $1.75B), $48.43M/qtr SBC, and the complex Up-C dual-class share structure (128.9M Class A shares vs ~605M total diluted units implied by $19.53B market cap) as reasons for multiple compression.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Q3's working-capital outflow was purely milestone-billing timing following three consecutive quarters of massive OCF (+$530.7M, +$191.5M, +$261.3M). With shares down ~20% into the print ($32.27 vs $59.84 mean PT) and 31.55% short float, a clean Q4 OCF rebound + $810M+ Q1 guide triggers a sharp squeeze.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: Management: Can you quantify the milestone-billing timing reversal expected in Q4 FY26 Operating Cash Flow and outline your FY27 Free Cash Flow conversion framework relative to Adjusted EBITDA?
